questions.q:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Statement: The bank has introduced green bonds to fund eco-friendly projects.

Conclusions:

I. The bank is supporting sustainable development.

II. Green bonds are more profitable than regular bonds.
questions.solution:
Funding eco-friendly projects supports sustainable development. The statement gives no comparison of profitability with other bonds.

**Answer: Only I follow**

questions.q: A is the daughter of B. B is the son of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
questions.solution:
B and D are children of C. A is B’s daughter, so A is D’s niece.

**Answer: Niece**

questions.q:
Solve:

AC : DF :: GI : ?
questions.solution:
Each letter advances three places: A-C becomes D-F, so G-I becomes J-L.

**Answer: JL**

questions.q: Complete the pattern: **1, 4, 13, 40, 121, ?**
questions.solution:
Multiply by three and add one at every step. After 121, the next term is 121 × 3 + 1 = 364.

**Answer: 364**

questions.q:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the action that follows.

Statement: Students often get distracted during online classes.

Course of Action:

1. Introduce interactive tools and quizzes.

2. Ban online classes permanently.
questions.solution:
Interactive tools directly address distraction during online classes. Permanently banning the classes is an excessive response.

**Answer: Only 1 follows**

questions.q:
Direction: Read the given information carefully and answer the questions asked below.

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G live on seven different floors of a building but not necessarily in the same order. The lowermost floor of the building is numbered as 1 and topmost floor is numbered as 7. A does not live on the topmost floor. B lives immediately below F. C lives on an even-numbered floor. Three people live between F and C. The number of people living between F and D is equal to the number of people living between D and C. More than four people live between E and G. B lives on one of the floors below G.

Who among the following lives two floors below A?
questions.solution:
The floor order from bottom to top is E, C, A, D, B, F, G. E occupies floor 1, which is two floors below A on floor 3.

**Answer: E**

questions.q:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All actors are professionals. All professionals are creative. Some creative people are lazy.

Conclusions:

I. Some actors are lazy.

II. All actors are creative.
questions.solution:
All actors are professionals and all professionals are creative, so all actors are creative. The lazy creative people need not be actors.

**Answer: Only II follows**

questions.q:
Find the odd one out:

Square, Triangle, Rectangle, Sphere, Pentagon
questions.solution:
A sphere is three-dimensional. Square, triangle, rectangle, and pentagon are plane figures.

**Answer: Sphere**

questions.q: In each of the following questions, a specific letter-to-letter coding pattern is applied to the first word to obtain the second word. Apply the same pattern to the third word and choose the correct option from the given alternatives. **xxyzyy : ccbabb :: xyyzzy : ?**
questions.solution:
The mapping is x→c, y→b, and z→a. Applying it to x-y-y-z-z-y gives c-b-b-a-a-b.

**Answer: cbbaab**

questions.q: Find the odd one out from the given alternatives:

questions.q: Which of the following words is formed by changing exactly one letter at one place in the word "PROFESSION"?
questions.solution:
PROFESSION changes to PROCESSION by replacing only the fourth letter F with C. The other options require additional changes.

**Answer: PROCESSION**

questions.q:
Complete the series.

60, 30, 20, 15, 12, 10, ?
questions.solution:
The terms are 60/1, 60/2, 60/3, and so on. The next is 60/7 ≈ 8.57.

**Answer: 8.57**

questions.q:
What comes next?

DZA, FXC, HVE, ?
questions.solution:
The first and third positions advance two letters while the middle position retreats two. H-V-E becomes J-T-G.

**Answer: JTG**

questions.q:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series:

**AZ, BY, CX, ?**
questions.solution:
The first letter advances while the second retreats: A-Z, B-Y, C-X, D-W.

**Answer: DW**

questions.q: A group of 20 students are sitting in a circle. Each shakes hands with exactly 3 neighbors. How many handshakes occur?
questions.solution:
There are 20 × 3 handshake incidences. Each handshake is counted at its two ends, so the total is 60/2 = 30.

**Answer: 30**

questions.q: If the 7th day of a month is three days earlier than Friday, What day will it be on the 20th day of the month?
questions.solution:
Three days before Friday is Tuesday. The 20th is 13 days after the 7th, so it falls on Monday.

**Answer: Monday**

questions.q: The series given below contains a sequence of numbers. Accordingly identify the incorrect combination.9, 17, 36, 72, 144, 288
questions.solution:
The intended sequence doubles: 9, 18, 36, 72, 144, 288. Therefore 17 is the incorrect term.

**Answer: 17**
